_readme: Weekly training by team id. weekday uses iCalendar codes (MO TU WE TH FR SA SU). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. skip lists dates with no session. venue must match a name in venues.json or the league data, which is where footwear and address come from. The scraper folds these into the team calendars; the site reads this file directly.
